notes.title: Gauntlet Mode and Skins are LIVE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6620223/b287166e16c3bd4655be94e60c099f9462d3c7be.png[/img]Today we launch a brand new game mode; [b]Gauntlet Mode[/b] is all about seed-value based generated levels.

You can [b]randomize[/b] the seed to play different levels. Returning to a level is simply a matter of typing in the same seed value! Seeds are simple text strings that look like this [b]24-LOL[/b]

We hope to get your feedback on Gauntlet Mode so we can tune the system to generate a large variety of levels. Let us know what you think on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/311930/discussions/]Discussion Boards[/url].

This update also adds unlockable skins for Weldon. Our next big feature update will be something special, have your headsets ready ;) Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Fellow Tinertia Fans,

We've been working hard on upgrading your rocket jumping experience and here's what to expect in the [b]Version 2.0.0 Update[/b] dropping this month:
[list]
[*] Tinertia has been massively upgraded: This means shiny new graphics, updated lighting, and better performance!

[*] Better Physics: The new Physics has some key improvements for example: wall-sliding is much smoother, and shooting off of floors & ceilings will now be very consistent. This will lead to some faster speed-runs :D

[*] We've tweaked some levels that spiked the difficulty curve in Worlds 2 & 3.

[*] We plan to [b]reset[/b] the leaderboards to allow people to compete with the new improved physics.

[*] Our work on optimizing for consoles has made it to the PC version. This means better framerates with better graphics!

[*] Tinertia will now support higher resolutions like 2k & 4k.

[*] Major bug fixes for replays ( especially ARC boss ). Replays will now be very consistent with the playthrough.
[/list]

The updates after [b]Version 2.0.0[/b] will contain new features: We'll be adding [b]unlockable skins[/b] for getting time & par medals, and a new way to play Tinertia that's very immersive ;)

To tide you over here's a wallpaper created from a screenshot of Version 2.0.0, enjoy! [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/C2PrKXSVIAAXMVk.jpg:orig]Wallpaper 2560x1440px[/url]

notes.title: We're back!
notes.content:
I just wanted to update the community on some recent happenings. I had to stop all development on Tinertia for a few months due to a conflict with our previous publisher. Suffice to say that's all behind us now.

We're now working on a major update ( upgrading the game engine ) that will bring visual and performance improvements. We're also working on goodies that you can unlock with Time and Par medals.

As always we love to hear from the community about anything Tinertia. Feels great to be back, stay tuned :D

- vkidd

notes.title: New Input System v1.0.9
notes.content:
After many questions & requests for [b]Win10 native Xbox One[/b] controller support, it's finally here!

With this update we ripped out our old Input system in favor of a new one. Tinertia now has [b][u]native support for more controllers[/u][/b], allows plugging-in controllers [b][u]at runtime[/u][/b] and [b][u]Rumble[/u][/b] for XInput controllers!

Here's the new list of supported Controllers:
[list]
[*]Sony DualShock 4 (Wired & Bluetooth)
[*]Sony DualShock 3 (Wired & Bluetooth)
[*]Sony DualShock 2 (My-Power CO., LTD Adapter)
[*]Sony DualShock 2 (Insten Adapter)
[*]Microsoft XBox One Controller
[*]Microsoft XBox 360 Controller
[*]Logitech F710 (X mode & D mode)
[*]Logitech F310 (X mode & D mode)
[*]Logitech RumblePad 2 USB
[*]GameCube Controller (Mayflash 2-port USB adapter, Mayflash 2-port adapter for WiiU & PC, Mayflash 4-port adapter for WiiU & PC)
[*]WiiU Pro Controller (Mayflash Wireless USB adapter)
[*]Mad Catz C.T.R.L.R
[*]Mad Catz Micro C.T.R.L.R
[*]SteelSeries FREE
[*]SteelSeries Stratus XL
[*]Thrustmaster Score-A
[/list]

Even if your controller is not on the list odds are it will still work great. In case it doesn't let us know on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/311930/discussions/0/618460171314742442/]Controller Support[/url] Thread.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 now live
notes.content:
This new build comes with changes to a few of our achievements.  Based on completition percentages we found the "Complete speed run without dying" style achievements weren't compelling users to complete them.  Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*]Exceedingly Efficient - Beat Command-02 without stunning any Drones.
[*]Aim For The Bushes - Beat Guardian without using Air-Dash.
[*]Days Without Injury - Beat Factory-02 without touching the ground.
[*]Bootstraps - Beat Drone RamR0D without rocket jumping on it.
[*]Royal Flush - Beat Sewers-07 under 7 seconds.
[*]Set Lasers To Stun - Beat Mines-01 without touching the ground.
[*]Baby Steps - Beat ReCyclops without shooting it.
[*]To The Moon - Speed-Run any World under 5 minutes.
[/list]
In addition to the achievement changes this build also features some art improvements and optimizations in various levels.

Let us know what you think of the changes in the forums, and happy exploding!

-Pherg

notes.title: Xbox One controller on Windows 10
notes.content:
Just wanted to update the community on an issue with Xbox One controllers on Windows 10.

If you're noticing strange input behavior  ( eg. left stick and DPads constantly pushing left ) the issue is caused by the new Windows 10 driver for the controller.

Tinertia is not the only game affected by this and we're working to get a fix asap. The interim [b]solution[/b] to get this working is to revert the controller driver to the Windows 8.1 version. You can find it [url=http://support.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-on-windows/accessories/connect-xbox-one-controller-to-pc] here [/url]

Optionally you can also use Xbox360, DS4, DS3 or Logitech controllers. Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/311930/discussions/0/618460171314742442/]Controller Discussion[/url] for more details.

notes.title: Tinertia Launch Day!
notes.content:
66 levels. 7 bosses. Lots of fist pumping victories.

[url=https://youtu.be/Ce7HtzMe98w] Check out the launch trailer here. [/url]

After a year in early access Tinertia is finally ready for prime time!  

We'd like to thank all the players who helped us build this explosive platformer. All the feedback on forums, playtests on twitch, and leaderboard rumbles have helped Tinertia become what it is today.

notes.title: Leaderboard Replays / Ghosts & Leaderboard Reset
notes.content:
We have 2 features coming to Early Access in the following weeks:
[list]
[*] Ability to watch a Replay of any score on the leaderboards.
[*] Ability to show a Ghost of a leaderboard score while playing a level.
[/list]

Unfortunately, in order to support this, we need to wipe the leaderboard data. We did consider methods of implementing Replays / Ghosts without the wipe. Reseting the data allows us to properly test these features and create a consistent experience for everyone.

The reset will happen in concert with the release of the Ghost features. Ideally it should be a one time thing unless we run in to bugs.

On the upside, how cool would it be to watch the top players fly through levels! As always let us know what you think on the forums.

- Optimizations in Core, Mines, Sewers that improve performance and framerate stability.
